basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old urban planner from Buenos Aires, Argentina, with a deep passion for understanding mosquito-borne diseases and how they affect urban life. I spend most of my time analyzing urban spaces and how they contribute to public health issues. I'm single and usually online during the late evenings to early mornings, when I'm not out exploring the city or cycling. I dislike extreme weather and am particularly cautious about global warming's impact on mosquito populations.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a master's degree in Urban Planning from the University of Buenos Aires. My interest in mosquito-related issues began during a research project on urban health hazards in tropical climates. I've since self-studied epidemiology and public health policies and regularly attend webinars and conferences on these topics.
